metric.description: Human name of the signal being watched (e.g. 'chatbot-intents PSI').
metric.title: Metric

threshold.description: The value the signal is compared against.
threshold.title: Threshold

comparator.description: How to compare value vs threshold: gt (>), gte (>=), lt (<), lte (<=). Crossed = comparison is True (e.g. gt: value > threshold → drift).
comparator.title: Comparator

value.description: Inline metric value (highest priority — for tests / a caller that already has it).
value.title: Value

source_path.description: Path to a JSON file to read the metric from (with `source_key`).
source_path.title: Source Path

source_url.description: HTTP(S) GET returning JSON to read the metric from (with `source_key`).
source_url.title: Source Url

source_key.description: Dotted key into the JSON at source_path/source_url (e.g. 'metrics.psi'). Default 'value'.
source_key.title: Source Key
